label: <DEL> delimiter step of the longest (L=9) sequences
explanation: Fires only at the <DEL> delimiter step (100% of activation mass); it never fires during the original or copy phases (1 stray step). It depends strongly on sequence length: about 63% of L=9 delimiters fire (89% of mass), about 14% of L=8 delimiters fire (11% of mass, weaker), and almost none for L<=7. Within L=9, whether it fires and how strongly depends on the sequence content in a spread-out way. Starting with q, e, y, f, d or 0 raises the rate (q about 2x), and more digits in the sequence raise it gradually. No simple token rule separates firing from non-firing L=9 delimiters: first-token filters trade recall for precision and lower F1. Magnitude is small (max 0.04 above threshold), and the strongest activations are all L=9 delimiters.
